name: Bamboo AI spoofable sale activation and pair-burn drain
summary: BambooAI._transfer set sale = block.number on any addressDev-to-pair transfer, and transferFrom(addressDev, pair, 0) needed no allowance, so anyone could switch on updatePool. That moved 1% of every non-pair transfer amount out of the pair's BAMBOO balance and synced, so loops of self-transfers shrank the BAMBOO reserve and let attackers sell into it for the pair's WBNB.
notes: The anchor is the zero-amount transferFrom that activated the pair burn (sale was 0 until then); the drains followed. setTrading(true) at block 29668034 is a trading gate, not a reset.

Campaign: every transaction with 20 or more BAMBOO Transfer events (the 300-transfer drain loops) from the anchor on; four actors, the largest 0x16c4da1a (216.34 WBNB), the anchor's sender 11.91 WBNB. None before the anchor.
Loss is the pair's WBNB depletion; the BAMBOO moved out of the pair is realised through that WBNB and not counted again.
